print.phoneText:
ADDITIVE MANUFACTURING STUDIO

Print Lab

Shape a model, understand its physical scale and material tradeoffs, and prepare evidence for a staff-reviewed print request. Nothing here spends points or starts a printer.

1. Design
2. Preflight
3. Materials
4. Submit

LOCAL CONNECTED-TOOL HANDOFF

From Geometry World

The STL preview is physical geometry. A separate editable block recipe is held only in this open session so shapes and rotations are not lost.

Default: 5 mm / block
CONNECTED BLOCKS
44
SHAPED PIECES
12
STL TRIANGLES
308
BLOCK ENVELOPE
6 × 4 × 5 blocks

CURRENT PHYSICAL SIZE

120 × 80 × 100 mm

Exact STL mesh envelope at 20 mm per Geometry World block. Width × depth × height.

Reset to 5 mm / block
Check this model
Revise in Geometry World
Download editable block source

Virtual Stone, Wood, Gold, and other block labels describe appearance only. Select the actual school filament in Materials after reviewing its properties and end-of-life limits.

Start a different model
3D preview

Drag to orbit. Use the controls below for a keyboard path.

↶
↷
+
−
Reset

This preview is a still picture of the model. Use the rotate, zoom and reset buttons above it to change the view; the Preflight tab holds the full text report of dimensions and printability checks.

Physical scale

SCALE PRESETS

Draft
2.5 mm / block
Default
5 mm / block
Large
10 mm / block
Millimeters per Geometry World block

Current mesh envelope: 120 × 80 × 100 mm (width × depth × height).

Outside the current printer envelope. The width dimension is too large for 100 × 100 × 110 mm. Choose a smaller scale or revise the model.
Suggested safe-fit scale: 15 mm per block

Width is the limiting dimension. This targets a usable 90 × 90 × 100 mm envelope, preserving 5 mm on every edge. Printer clips, purge lines, and machine keep-out zones still require slicer and staff review.
